name: Vectras Enprocon
summary: Vectras Enprocon is a Gujarat-based EPC contractor for the midstream and downstream oil and gas sector, building pipelines, combined stations and refinery and terminal piping works, and offering inspection and testing services. Revenue rose from ₹54.3 cr in FY24 to ₹119.8 cr in FY26 and profit grew 51.7% in FY26 to ₹15.4 cr, but operating cash flow was negative in each of the three years and borrowings grew much faster than revenue. The top 10 customers made up 92.3% of FY26 revenue, and the two selling promoters acquired their shares at an average of ₹4. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 13.0x on FY26 profit, below the median of the listed peers named in the RHP.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹54.3 cr (FY24) to ₹119.8 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 48.5%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹54.3 cr, ₹80.5 cr, ₹119.8 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.59 in FY26 and 0.67 at September 2026.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose more than fivefold (₹4.2 cr to ₹22.2 cr) while revenue rose 120% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹12.2 cr, ₹22.3 cr, ₹37.8 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was negative at -₹5.1 cr in FY26, against a profit of ₹15.4 cr.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 51.7% in FY26, from ₹10.2 cr to ₹15.4 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from about 10.7% (FY24) to 12.6% (FY25) and 12.9% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 51.4% in FY26, helped by the small equity base.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 48.4% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: FY26 PAT margin of 12.9% vs a peer median of about 9.1% (Pratham EPC 4.4%, Desco Infratech 13.8%).

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 13.0x (₹200.1 cr market cap vs ₹15.4 cr FY26 profit) vs a peer median of 22.4x (Pratham EPC 34.5x, Likhitha 22.4x, Desco 8.4x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.49x (₹200.1 cr vs ₹80.3 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of about 2.13x, roughly 17% above.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: FY26 sales to related firm M/s Vectras were ₹17.1 cr, about 14% of revenue, with ₹11.8 cr of purchases from it.
